meta.source: Signal official desktop/mobile screenshots + logo pack (assignment), and the Figma file 'Signal | App Recreation (Community)' decoded directly (variables, text styles, radii, icon geometry). Desktop values come from the official desktop screenshots; mobile/iOS values (ios-*) are exact Figma values at 1x (390x844 frame).

tokens.name: ultramarine
tokens.usage: App accent on DESKTOP (official Signal desktop screenshots): outgoing bubbles, unread badge, primary buttons, focus ring. On phones the Figma's ios-ultramarine (#305ee7) takes over via bundle.css.

tokens.name: ultramarine-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of ultramarine buttons.

tokens.name: on-ultramarine
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ultramarine (outgoing bubble text, badge numerals).

tokens.name: on-ultramarine-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamp and status icons inside outgoing bubbles. Source pair: ~3.9:1 at 11px, below 4.5:1 — kept to match Signal; use on-ultramarine where legibility matters.

tokens.name: brand-ultramarine
tokens.usage: Logo ink only (from the logo SVGs). Never use it for UI — the app accent is ultramarine.

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the 'logo on wash' lockup; onboarding hero panels.

tokens.name: surface-pane
tokens.usage: Chat pane / conversation background (desktop). Mobile dark uses surface-pane-mobile.

tokens.name: surface-pane-mobile
